Sturdy Posture Support with Great Value (Minor Bulk Issues) Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5) Executive Summary The Vive Upright Rollator is an excellent investment for those looking to improve their gait and reduce back strain without breaking the bank. It offers a premium, sturdy build and a high level of accessibility through flexible payment options. While it excels in stability, users with compact vehicles or those who frequent crowded spaces should be aware of its physical footprint. Pros Superior Ergonomics: The upright design significantly improves posture compared to traditional rollators, effectively shifting weight from the lower back to the forearms. Out-of-the-Box Ready: It comes almost fully assembled, which is a massive plus for those with limited hand dexterity or strength. Build Quality: Very sturdy and reliable on various surfaces. It feels safe and well-engineered. Price Accessibility: The price point is highly competitive. Cons & Considerations Transportability: Even though the height is adjustable, the upright armrests make the unit quite bulky. It can be a challenge to fit into smaller trunks or hatchbacks without lowering the armrests first. Seated Visibility: When used as a seat, the armrest structure can partially obstruct your peripheral view. This can create a slight sense of anxiety in crowded or busy venues where you want a clear line of sight. Final Verdict This is a high-quality mobility aid that delivers on its promises. If you have a larger vehicle or primarily use it in open spaces, it is easily a 5-star product. However, the bulkiness of the armrests is a necessary trade-off for the postural benefits it provides.

Good walker not durable arm rest

I love the ability to walk upright. The main problem I had is eighths arm rest splitting within a few weeks of owning it. They say the arm rest are durable bit they are not. The store did honor the warranty and replaced both arm rest. They said I would have to buy the next ones. I have talked to others that had this same brand and they had the same problem. It may be best to get the name brand of the "Up Right" walker. My PT has one and has had it for years and is in great condition, with no problems with the arm rest.

J

June (New Baltimore, US)

Change of opinion......

I posted an earlier review when my back was in terrible condition. I have since had a spinal fusion and discectomy. I am currently rehabbing from that, and I could not do it without my upwalker. I had posted that the seat wasn't really locking down, but I have the hang of it now, and it locks well. Also, the reason the wheels were catching was because I was probably putting too much weight on my arms due to the very messed up spine. Since the fusion, I need to stand very tall and feel the curve behind my waist. Today I walked 1.6 miles with my upwalker. I no longer put much weight on my arms, but I still have to watch the pavement to make sure I'm not hitting uneven concrete or it will still catch. I wish the wheels were just a tad squishier so they wouldn't do that. But really, I just told my husband, "This is the best mobility device I have ever had....and I think I've had just about all of them over the years. I love this thing, and am so happy I have it.

Thank you for your updated feedback, June! We're thrilled to hear that the Upright Rollator has been instrumental in your post-surgery recovery. It's wonderful to know you consider it the best mobility device. -Sara- Vive Health.

The Vive Health Upright Rollator is a four-wheel walker built to keep you standing tall instead of hunched over the bars. It has a padded seat that folds into a transport chair, so a companion can push you when walking gets hard. Reviewers rate it highly, and the upright posture is the feature most often singled out. It suits people who need steady support for longer walks and want a seat to rest on. Against basic rollators it adds the transport function and forearm supports; it is heavier and bulkier than a plain folding walker.

## About the Upright Rollator - Walker with Foldable Transport Seat

The Upright Rollator is a stand-up walker with a foldable transport seat. It keeps the user in an upright posture, so they can look forward while walking instead of hunching over. This reduces the neck, shoulder and back strain that traditional walkers can cause.

The frame is made of aircraft-grade aluminum. The walker weighs 20 pounds and supports up to 300 pounds. Its height adjusts from 41 to 46 inches, which fits users from 5'2" to 6'4". Hand brakes control speed on inclines and lock the wheels when the user is seated. The padded seat has a backrest for rest stops.

The walker folds to 10.8 inches wide to fit in a car trunk or closet. Its 8-inch flat-free wheels need no air and are made for indoor floors and outdoor paths. A detachable shoulder bag and an integrated cane holder are included.

## Questions and answers

Does it really help you stand upright?

Yes. The handles and forearm supports are set high so you walk behind the frame rather than leaning on it, which keeps the spine straighter. Owners with back and shoulder pain report the difference.

Can someone push me in it?

Yes. The padded seat folds into a transport chair, and a caregiver can push it from behind. The hand brakes lock the wheels when you sit or stand.

How does it compare with a standard rollator?

A standard rollator gives you a seat and a basket. This one adds the upright walking position and the transport-chair function, at the cost of more weight and bulk.

Is it good outdoors?

The four wheels handle pavement, paths and indoor floors. It is not made for stairs, gravel or rough ground.

What is in the box?

The walker arrives unassembled with its frame, wheels, seat and handles. Assembly is required before first use.

Is it covered by a warranty?

It carries a one-year guarantee from the manufacturer.

results.text:
# Vive Mobility Upright Walker with Seat, for Seniors, Women - Stand Up Rollator, Arm Rests, Heavy Duty, Folding Medical Aid Scooter for Elderly, Seniors - Walking Foldable Assist
Brand: Vive Mobility
Category: Walkers, Rollators & Accessories > Rolling Walkers

## Features
SUPPORTS WALKING UPRIGHT ON ANY SURFACE: The Vive Upright Walker is a superior alternative to ordinary walkers. It can help improve your posture and confidence. It can also help reduce pain in your neck, hips, knees, hands, and wrists. The upright rollator walker features 8”, flat-free wheels for greater stability on many surfaces, and its forearm pads adjust forward and backward, better accommodating different arm lengths.; IDEAL FOR HEIGHTS 5'2" - 6'4": Locking push pins allow the height of the Vive upright rollator walker handles to be easily adjusted from 45” to 52” in height (ideal for heights 5'2" to 6'4"). The folding walker handles are topped with contoured armrests to evenly distribute pressure, relieving fatigue and length adjustable hand grips with easy to use loop brakes to lock the wheels in place for stable seating.; COMFORTABLE ON THE GO SEATING: Featuring a supportive, 17.5” wide seat, the tall upright rollator walker provides comfortable, on-the-go seating for resting as needed. The folding rollator also includes a detachable shoulder bag that safely stores essential items close at hand.; FOLDABLE DESIGN: Constructed with a durable aluminum frame, the Vive upright rollator walker is exceptionally durable, safely supporting up to 300 pounds. Easy to transport, the tall rollator walker folds for compact storage,fitting in the trunk of a car or even in the backseat. It weighs 20 pounds (a few pounds less than competitors).; VIVE 1-YEAR GUARANTEE: Confident in its durability and safety, we offer a 1-year guarantee.
